title: Assembly: Step By Step
description: Practice step by step in Assembly.

codeTemplate.asm:
; step by step
section .data
    msg db 'step by step',0
section .text
    global _start
_start:
    mov eax,4
    mov ebx,1
    mov ecx,msg
    int 0x80
    mov eax,1
    xor ebx,ebx
    int 0x80
